literal: Delay, forgetfulness, laziness, sleep - all four [are] the desired vessel of those of ruinous nature.
translation: Procrastination, forgetfulness, laziness, and excessive sleep—these four are the chosen vessels of those destined for ruin.
modern: காலம் தாழ்த்துதல், மறதி, சோம்பல், தூக்கம் ஆகிய இந்த நான்கும், அழியும் இயல்புடையவர்கள் விரும்பி ஏறும் கப்பல் ஆகும்.
explanation: The couplet lists four negative traits: procrastination, forgetfulness, laziness, and excessive sleep. It describes these four as the desired vessel or boat (காமக் கலன்) for people whose nature leads them to ruin (கெடுநீரார்). Just as a traveler chooses a boat to reach a destination, those heading toward destruction willingly embrace these four habits. By recognizing and avoiding these traits, one can escape the path to failure.
